c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: BMI Federal Credit Union's official Refer A Friend card (Q3 2026, bmifcu.org/docs/Refer A Friend Card_Q3_2026.pdf) runs a refer-a-friend program paying the referring member $100 cash per qualifying referral.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: a cash bonus of $100 deposited to the referring member's savings account for each qualifying referral; limit of five (5) referrals per member ($500 max).

c3.evidence: Mechanism: the new member mentions the referring member's name when the account is opened (or the referrer gives them the card); the new member enters promo code FRIEND26. The $100 cash bonus is deposited to the referring member's savings account within 10 business days after the New Member Offer is qualified.

c4.evidence: Timing: the $100 cash bonus is deposited to the referring member's savings account within 10 business days after the New Member Offer is qualified.

eligibility: Existing BMI FCU members; the new member must meet the offer qualifications (open and deposit $20 into a new checking account, make 30 Visa debit card transactions of at least $5 each within 90 days, sign up for electronic statements).
notes: BMI Federal Credit Union is open to people who live, work, worship, or attend school in Franklin, Licking, Fairfield, Pickaway, Madison, Union, Delaware, or Morrow County. Distinct from R2161's free-checking page. Offer ends September 30, 2026 — nearly expired; flag if still advertised.
payout_quote: Cash bonus of $100 will be deposited to referring member's savings account within 10 business days after the New Member Offer is qualified. Limit of five (5) referrals per member.

s1.note: No upfront fee charged to the referrer.

s2.note: Referral is free; no cost to refer.

s3.note: Cash bonus may be considered income and reported on 1099-MISC or 1099-INT.

s4.note: Cap: limit of five (5) referrals per member ($500 max).

s5.note: Offer ends September 30, 2026; current as of observation 2026-09-23; BMI FCU may amend, suspend, or discontinue at any time.

s6.note: Referral mechanics stated on the official card: new member mentions the referring member's name at account opening and enters promo code FRIEND26.

s7.note: Friend-side qualifying actions: within 90 days of account opening, open and deposit $20 into a new checking account, make at least 30 Visa debit card transactions of $5 or more, and sign up for electronic statements; account must stay open 12 months or the bonus is clawed back.
